items.name: Glimmer Shard
items.description: A sliver of crystal that hums faintly near hidden caches.

items.name: Wayfarer Coin
items.description: Old trade coin stamped with a compass rose. Merchants love these.

items.name: Trail Map Fragment
items.description: Part of a map that redraws itself as you explore.

items.name: Ancient Compass
items.description: Its needle points to places nobody has visited in a long time.

items.name: Sunken Hourglass
items.description: Sand flows upward inside. Recovered from a flooded vault.

items.name: Tidecaller Crown
items.description: One of only 250. Legend says it chooses its finder.

items.name: Ember Egg
items.description: Warm to the touch. Only 50 will ever exist.

items.name: Pioneer Badge
items.description: Awarded for your very first discovery. Soulbound.

items.name: Cartographer's Seal
items.description: Proof that you charted new ground. Soulbound.

items.name: Ember Frame
items.description: A smouldering profile frame for long-distance explorers.

items.name: Aurora Frame
items.description: Shimmering profile frame traded by the Merchant.

items.name: Harvest Moon Token
items.description: Event collectible from the November 2026 Harvest Moon Hunt.

npcs.name: Ines Vale
npcs.title: The Cartographer
npcs.personality: Precise, curious, quietly competitive. Measures everything twice.
npcs.greeting: Every street you walk is a line on my map. Bring me new lines.
lines: Blank spaces on a map are just invitations.
You walked 400 metres north yesterday. I noticed.
A good explorer never takes the same path twice.

npcs.name: Bram Cogsworth
npcs.title: The Merchant
npcs.personality: Warm, shrewd, always negotiating. Runs the only shop that never closes.
npcs.greeting: Everything has a price, friend. Today, mine are fair. Tomorrow? Ask the curve.
lines: Prices rise when you buy and fall when you sell. That is the whole secret.
My treasury pays for what I buy back. When it runs dry, I stop buying.
A 2.5% cut of every player trade keeps my coffers honest.

npcs.name: Oru
npcs.title: The Treasure Keeper
npcs.personality: Ancient, cryptic, generous to the worthy. Guards a finite vault.
npcs.greeting: My vault is not bottomless. Prove yourself, and a piece of it is yours.
lines: Only so many relics remain. When they are gone, they are gone.
The vault remembers every hand that took from it.

npcs.name: Kaia Ridge
npcs.title: The Explorer
npcs.personality: Energetic, encouraging, allergic to sitting still.
npcs.greeting: Lace up! The best treasure is always one more block away.
lines: Distance is the only currency I trust.
Rain? Perfect. Fewer hunters out there.
Keep your streak alive and the world opens up.

missions.title: First Steps
missions.intro: Everyone remembers their first find. Go make yours.
missions.outro: That look on your face? That's why we do this. Keep the badge.

missions.title: The Long Road
missions.description: Travel 3 km while on this mission.
missions.intro: Three kilometres. On foot. No shortcuts.
missions.outro: Legs still working? Good. This frame suits you.

missions.title: Chart the Unknown
missions.description: Visit 3 places you have never been to in TREZO.
missions.intro: My map has gaps. Fill three of them.
missions.outro: Three new lines. Here, this fragment shows where they lead.

missions.title: Grid Walker
missions.description: Travel 1.5 km while on this mission.
missions.intro: Walk the grid. I'll be measuring.
missions.outro: Precise work. You've earned my seal.

missions.title: The Keeper's Trial
missions.description: Find a Rare or better treasure. Costs 50 Shards to begin.
missions.intro: Pay the toll and seek something rare. The vault will answer.
missions.outro: Worthy. Take the compass — the vault has fewer of them now.

missions.title: Vault of Echoes
missions.description: Find an Epic or Legendary treasure. Costs 150 Shards to begin.
missions.intro: The deeper vault opens only for the truly fortunate.
missions.outro: The lantern is yours. Only a few hundred remain.

missions.title: Fair Trade
missions.description: Hand over 3 Glimmer Shards for a Trail Map Fragment.
missions.intro: Three glimmers for a map. Fair, no?
missions.outro: Pleasure doing business. Come back any time.

missions.title: Aurora Exchange
missions.description: Trade 3 Wayfarer Coins and 120 Shards for a limited Aurora Frame.
missions.intro: Only a thousand of these frames will leave my shop.
missions.outro: Wear it well. Supply just got a little tighter.

quests.title: Somewhere New
quests.description: Visit a location you have never explored before.

quests.title: Rare Sighting
quests.description: Find a Rare or better treasure this week.

quests.title: Harvest Moon Hunt
quests.description: Limited-time: find 5 treasures during the Harvest Moon event. Entry costs 100 Shards.

quests.title: Community Challenge: 2,500 Finds
quests.description: All TREZO players together discover 2,500 treasures this season. Contribute at least 3 finds to share the reward.

quests.title: Rare Collectible Hunt: Ember Egg
quests.description: Find a Legendary treasure this season to claim one of only 50 Ember Eggs.

quests.title: Season 1: First Light
quests.description: Reach level 8 before the season ends.

shop.name: Radar Pulse
shop.description: Doubles your claim radius for the next 30 minutes.
